items.title: Pete Jolly interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: Barbara Carroll, Quincy, Al Cohn, Ernie Wilkins, Andre, Billy Byers, Milt Bernhart, Joe Newman.

ctx.x: Oh Art Mardigan. And Buddy Clark. They did that with me, not Shelly. Yeah it was Art Mardigan. Okay that was recorded again during that March period, ’55. That was the same time I did my first album. Yeah, boy, I’ve got this around someplace, but Barbara Carroll, Quincy, Al Cohn, Ernie Wilkins, Andre, Billy Byers, Milt Bernhart, Joe Newman.
Nice, huh? Well if you can’t find yours, I’ll let you buy this from me. How’s that?
